summary: Validated the reported admin menu image-loss fix + removal-table auto-save + uses_sauces flag + cart sauce identity. Backend: 8/8 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_menu_image_and_sauces.py — (a) POST /api/admin/menu with a 1×1 PNG data URL sets has_image=true and GET /api/menu/{id}/image returns the bytes; (b) PUT /api/admin/menu/{id} sending only {name, removable_ingredients, uses_sauces} (no image_base64) keeps has_image=true and the image endpoint still returns bytes — the reported disappearance bug is FIXED end-to-end; (c) PUT with explicit image_base64: null likewise preserves image (server pops null from changes before applying — server.py L466-470); (d) PUT with only {removable_ingredients} (mimicking auto-save table edits) persists and preserves the image; (e) /api/checkout/quote with sauces on an item where uses_sauces=false is rejected 400 with 'sauce' error (order_service.py L103-107); (f) same payload on uses_sauces=true item returns 200 and sauce survives in the quote snapshot; (g) public /api/menu exposes uses_sauces field. All TEST-prefixed items and the ephemeral TEST_SAUCE_UI item deleted at teardown; no menu mutations left behind. Frontend (Playwright): admin editor at 1920×1080 opens table with 5 presets + custom-add input + delete rows, 'Enregistré automatiquement' label present under [data-testid=menu-removals-save-status], preset toggle round-trip auto-saves without pressing Enregistrer (image endpoint status stayed 404 for the no-image item both before and after — no regression), uses_sauces checkbox labelled 'Proposer des sauces pour ce plat'. Editor at 390×844: documentElement/body scrollWidth = 390 (no document-level horizontal overflow); one absolute-positioned rotate-6 'Rupture' badge sits 6px beyond due to its transform but does NOT expand the doc scroll rect. Public /menu at 1920: created ephemeral TEST_SAUCE_UI (uses_sauces=true), clicked configure → Sauces label + 12 sauce chips appear (Ketchup, Algérienne, …); add with Ketchup → 1 line; add again with Algérienne → 2 SEPARATE lines (sauces=[Ketchup] and sauces=[Algérienne]); add again with Ketchup → merges with first line (qty=2), Algérienne line qty stays 1. CartContext.jsx line-key includes sauces (L41) so identity is honoured. Tablet at 768×1024 with tablet@burgertimes.fr: category → Burgers Signatures → TEST_SAUCE_UI card shows Sauces label + all 12 active chips inline; scrollWidth=768. SAFETY: no /api/tablet/orders POST, no kitchen accept/decline/reprint/test-print, no run of test_kitchen_flow.py. No physical print triggered.

issues: The rotate-6 'Rupture' badge inside the aspect-[4/3] preview extends ~6px past the viewport bounding box on some cards (maxRight=396). Purely cosmetic — document.scrollWidth stays 390, so no actual horizontal scroll appears. Consider clamping the overlay via overflow-hidden on its wrapper if the user wants a pixel-perfect edge.

critical_code_review_comments: admin_update_menu_item (server.py L461-475): correctly pops image_base64 from `changes` when None/empty and preserves has_image — this is exactly the fix the bug required. `payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` means fields not sent are never touched, so a PUT with just {removable_ingredients} does not clobber image_base64 or has_image.
MenuAdmin.jsx save() (L58-73) destructures out has_image and skips image_base64 unless truthy — matches server contract; no accidental image_base64: null sent on plain saves.

persistRemovals (L290-297) fires per toggle/blur/add/delete via PUT /admin/menu/{id} with only removable_ingredients — matches spec 'immediate persistence without pressing general Save'. Save status label ('Enregistrement…' / 'Enregistré automatiquement') gives clear feedback.
order_service.py L103-107 enforces server-side sauce ban when uses_sauces=false — verified 400 with clear French message.
CartContext.jsx L40-42: key includes sauces via `.join(',')` — different sauce sets never merge; identical sauce sets do merge quantities. Verified end-to-end in the UI.
AdminLayout.jsx wraps content in max-w-screen containers; MenuAdmin editor uses w-full md:max-w-2xl with table-fixed inside — no doc-level horizontal overflow at 390px.

Minor: public /api/menu omits `uses_sauces` on legacy docs that don't have the field yet (falsy on read is fine — frontend uses truthy check). Not a bug; noting for context. If a legacy item is toggled to uses_sauces via the admin PUT it starts appearing in /menu response.

rca of the issue: REPORTED BUG: admin editing a menu item without re-uploading the image made the photo disappear. ROOT CAUSE (previous code): admin_update_menu_item accepted MenuItemUpdate whose default image_base64=None was included in model_dump() and set image_base64=None in Mongo, then has_image was left true but /menu/{id}/image returned 404 (falsy image_base64). FIX (current code, server.py L465-470): use `model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` and, when image_base64 IS in the payload, only apply it if truthy — otherwise drop the key. Additionally MenuAdmin.jsx save() strips image_base64 unless truthy. Verified end-to-end: create item with image → PUT with just {name, removable_ingredients, uses_sauces} → has_image stays true, image endpoint still returns bytes. MITIGATION: keep exclude_unset=True on all admin PUT endpoints that carry optional binary blobs; on the frontend, never send image_base64: null unless the user explicitly clears the photo.
